entity_name: Ministry of Public Works and Transport (وزارة الأشغال العامة والنقل)

facts.value: Responsible for classified/national roads, bridges, highway maintenance, snow clearance on national routes, large public works, and transport regulation. Maintains regional offices with road units that handle citizen road complaints. Complaint domains encoded for routing: classified_road_damage, national_highway_pothole, bridge_damage, bridge_structural_risk, road_barrier_missing, traffic_sign_missing_national, snow_clearance_national_road, road_blocked_national, landslide_on_classified_road, unsafe_highway_work_zone, public_works_permit, transport_regulation, port_oversight, airport_oversight.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: local_municipal_roads(MUN); active_CDR_project_sites(CDR); water_infrastructure; electricity_infrastructure; national_or_classified_roads_highways_bridges; Route instead to MPWT when Municipality remains secondary only for local context.; ordinary_local_neighborhood_roads_and_sidewalks; Route instead to MUN when Do not use MPWT for every pothole.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. Route to MPWT when national/classified/highway evidence is present; keep HITL if road class is ambiguous. Bridge damage routes to MPWT for asset ownership review and CD if collapse or rescue danger is present.
facts.notes: Runtime routing may still need exact location, dynamic municipal resolution, or asset-owner confirmation.
